newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 13.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - State-run Taiwan Power Co decides to ship nuclear waste to North Korea.
Foreign ministers across Taiwan strait begin diplomatic war in Africa.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - State Taiwan Power Co signs contract with North Korea to store nuclear waste there.
Premier Lien Chan may visit another unknown country after visiting Vatican.
LIBERTY TIMES - Investigators find new evidence in killing at Taoyuan magistrate's residence.
State Taiwan Power Co finds location in North Korea to store island's nuclear waste.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan proposes to put aside arguments on flags in Taiwan-China shipping issue after July 1997.
Far East Air Transport, Foshing Airlines plan listings on over-the-counter market and main stock exchange.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Tax bureau to target major shareholders of new banks for tax evasion.
Finance Ministry to provide subsidies to help financial institutions to merge.
